name: Bala — Trail de Energía
generation_strategy: 1 imagen individual 1024×1024. Se recorta y resize a 64×16 en el script de proceso.

frames.role: Trail de energía detrás de la bala en movimiento
frames.prompt: A cartoon energy bullet trail/comet tail VFX sprite, horizontal orientation pointing LEFT, isolated on transparent background, centered. STYLE: vibrant warm cartoon FX. The trail is a glowing teardrop/flame streak shape — bright warm white (#FFFFFF) glowing hot on the RIGHT end (bullet position), transitioning through warm yellow to fully transparent on the LEFT (tail end). The streak is thin and fast-looking — narrow at both ends, widest near the right. A soft radiant warm glow around the bright end. Clean, snappy cartoon style. Will be tinted in-engine to match bullet bounce state color. NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic smoke, pixel art, background, text, watermark, thick trail, opaque at both ends, complex

phaser_config.notes: origin.x = 1.0 para que el extremo brillante (derecha) esté en la posición de la bala. Rotar en sentido contrario al movimiento. Tint con color de la bala actual.
